name: Central America — 7-country pilot
scope_note: AreaData pilot cohort of the seven sovereign states commonly described as Central America: Belize, Guatemala, El Salvador, Honduras, Nicaragua, Costa Rica and Panama. This is a project analysis scope, not the UN M49 Central America aggregate; UN M49 013 also includes Mexico.

scope_source.name: AreaData Central America seven-country pilot scope
scope_source.license: Project metadata; underlying country identities remain attributed to UN M49
scope_source.note: Defines only the analysis cohort. It is not an official published aggregate and does not imply that national census or municipal data have been acquired.

rules.label: AreaData calculated population
rules.note: This rule applies only to the same-period international reference series. Use each country's exact observation first. Descend to provinces or municipalities only when an official complete non-overlapping membership and compatible observations cover the entire country. Missing municipalities do not matter when the country total exists. A separate census rule may use latest_available_by_component and must expose every component year.
